explanation: Requested W = 1.2 GeV is below the p+eta production threshold (W_thr = m_p + m_eta = 0.93827 + 0.54786 = 1.48613 GeV) for ep -> e'p eta. At this W, eta electroproduction is kinematically forbidden: there is no phase space for the reaction, so no radiative correction is physically defined. This is also confirmed by the eta-channel EtaMAID-2023 hadronic model grid in mpintp.inc, whose W axis begins at 1.4856 GeV (NVAR2 comment: '1th: W=1485.6 MeV'), i.e. the table does not even cover W = 1.2 GeV. No EXCLURAD input file was generated. To proceed, request a W value at or above ~1.487 GeV (the README-documented valid range is W = 1.487-2.211 GeV for this eta configuration).
